population: river waterbodies with fully observed calendar years; reference never imputed
unit_of_analysis: station-year with a simulated outage realization
primary_endpoint: share of retained station-years whose completed-year hottest-30 absolute error exceeds 0.5 °C, at matched retention
tolerance_justification: 0.5 °C is 0.47 of the interannual standard deviation of the endpoint at these stations, so a year carrying that error can move a warm year into the normal range. It is not a probe-precision number; probe precision is the wrong scale for a screening decision.
incumbent: fixed outage-length threshold, the axis used by published guidance and agency completeness standards

primary_claim.statement: On reserved networks, at the retention of the matched fixed-length rule, the certificate reduces the consequential-error rate by at least 5.0 percentage points, with a network-clustered bootstrap interval excluding zero.

coverage.statement: marginal conformal coverage of the nominal 0.90 interval lies in [0.87, 0.93]

secondary_claims.mechanism: peak-window overlap outranks outage length in permutation importance on reserved networks
secondary_claims.per_year_use: misclassification of the 20 °C exceedance among retained years is lower than the matched length rule

precision.note: The reserved panel must resolve the declared effect by a comfortable multiple. v16 declared a 0.05 °C margin against a resolvable margin several times larger, so its confirmation could neither accept nor reject.

failure_conditions.primary_fails: report that the certificate does not beat fixed-length screening out of sample, keep the mechanism result (H1) and the calibrated-interval result (H3), and do not claim a screening advantage
failure_conditions.coverage_fails: report the interval as uncalibrated out of sample and restrict the certificate to ranking only
failure_conditions.both_fail: the paper reduces to the mechanism finding plus the v16 training-mismatch diagnosis

model.calibration: selection-conditional multiplicative split conformal, networks disjoint between fit, calibration and test
